event: Dow +3.0%, best post-midterm day in 44 years
detail: S&P +1.6%, Nasdaq +1.4%. Brent fell below $100; energy was the worst sector; defence and Nvidia slipped.
Shares fell about 5% to a four-month low on a profit miss and margin pressure.

event: Coherent beats; Arm and Qualcomm report
detail: Coherent: record $2.37B revenue, EPS $2.09 vs $1.80, ~$20B five-year optics deal. Arm revenue +27%. Qualcomm phone-chip sales fell 26% as Apple business shrinks.

S&P -4.4% (worst day since April 2025), Dow -1,833 points, Nasdaq in correction, VIX ~28. Fears that the new Congress slows data-centre building plus hedge-fund de-grossing. Nvidia, AMD, Micron, Marvell fell 9-17%.

event: Microsoft data-centre delay chatter hits neoclouds
detail: Reports that Microsoft declined a Texas data-centre contract extension with Nscale. IREN -14%, Nebius -14%, CoreWeave -9%.
S$2.81B vs S$2.95B expected on weaker trading income; 81-cent dividend kept; says interest income has bottomed. Shares +0.6%.

event: BoE hikes to 4%; Fed hike odds ease
detail: Markets now price ~70% odds of a Fed hike on Dec 9 (from 83%). WTI rose ~3% to about $91; bitcoin fell to ~$76K.

event: After the close: AAOI, IREN, Axon, Kratos, Affirm, Airbnb
detail: AAOI revenue +127% with a Q4 guide of $385-420M. IREN AI cloud revenue nearly tripled to ~$200M. Axon missed EPS by 19 cents.
Vistra is the most exposed to the Texas data-centre proposal.
